modules.title: Financial Modeling Fundamentals
modules.description: This module introduces the basics of financial modeling, including financial statement analysis, ratio calculation, and time value of money.

sub_modules.title: Statement Analysis
sub_modules.description: Learn how to analyze a company's financial statements, including income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement.

activities.title: Financial Statement Template
activities.description: Create a basic financial statement template using Excel or Google Sheets.

activities.title: Ratio Calculation
activities.description: Calculate and interpret key ratios, such as the debt-to-equity ratio and return on equity.

activities.title: Time Value of Money
activities.description: Understand how time affects the value of money, including present value and future value calculations.

sub_modules.title: Financial Modeling Techniques
sub_modules.description: Learn advanced techniques for financial modeling, including sensitivity analysis, scenario planning, and break-even analysis.

activities.title: Sensitivity Analysis
activities.description: Understand how to analyze the impact of changes in inputs on model outputs using sensitivity analysis techniques.

activities.title: Scenario Planning
activities.description: Learn how to create scenarios to forecast future financial outcomes, including market research and data collection.

activities.title: Break-Even Analysis
activities.description: Understand how to calculate the break-even point for a business or project using financial models.
